content: Resume-as-image (PNG/JPG) is not ATS-parseable and should never be a candidate's only resume artifact for actual job applications -- ATS systems and recruiters need selectable/copyable text. A resume image is fine for in-page visual display (fast, no PDF viewer chrome, matches this project's stated design direction) but should be paired with a downloadable text-based PDF version (the same resume, exported normally, not a scanned image) so visitors can obtain an ATS-safe copy.
